description: Get London airport transfer prices between a UK airport or cruise port and any UK address or postcode. Covers all London airports (Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, City Airport), Edinburgh Airport, and all major UK cruise ports (Southampton, Dover, Portsmouth). Transfers available to and from any UK postcode and address nationwide. Returns available car types with prices, passenger capacity, and luggage capacity. Use both passenger count and suitcase count to recommend the right car. CRITICAL — POSTCODE RULE: If the customer gives only a city, town, or area name (e.g. "Windsor", "Manchester", "Brighton", "central London") without a specific street address or full UK postcode, ALWAYS ask them for the full postcode (e.g. "SL4 5LP") or a precise address BEFORE calling this tool. UK city names cover wide areas — pricing and pickup accuracy depend on a specific postcode. Never guess, never substitute a default, and never proceed with just a city name. Hotel names are acceptable only if they are uniquely identifiable. The same rule applies to the pickup if it is not an airport or cruise port. IMPORTANT: The prices returned are FINAL — quote them to the customer exactly as provided. Do NOT apply discounts, do NOT calculate "your price after discount", do NOT modify the price in any way. APL does not offer ad-hoc discounts via this tool. ALWAYS tell the customer: "All prices are fixed and include Meet and Greet service inside the airport terminal — your driver waits for you at arrivals with a name board." This is a key feature of every APL booking and customers should know it is included. RENDERING: This tool returns each car's photo as inline image content (attached automatically alongside the text). The photos appear in the chat by themselves. In your reply, just write each car's caption ("Car Type — N passengers, N bags — £price") and the customer will see the matching photo above the caption. DO NOT include markdown image syntax like ![Car](URL) — that produces broken "Show Image" placeholders. Just text captions.

destination.description: Dropoff location — full UK postcode (e.g. "SL4 5LP" for Windsor), full street address, or a uniquely identifiable hotel/airport name. Do NOT pass a bare city/town/area name like "Windsor" or "Manchester" — UK cities cover wide areas and the price and pickup point will be wrong. If the customer gave only a city name, ask them for the full postcode before calling this tool.

origin.description: Pickup location — airport name (e.g. "Heathrow", "Gatwick"), full UK postcode (e.g. "SW1A 1AA"), or full street address. Do NOT pass a bare city/town name — ask the customer for the postcode first.

passengers.description: Number of passengers (determines recommended car type)

suitcases.description: Number of suitcases/large bags (helps recommend the right car)

transfer_date.description: REQUIRED — the customer's travel date as YYYY-MM-DD. You MUST ask the customer for their travel date and have their answer BEFORE calling this tool: the price depends on the date (seasonal / peak-date pricing), so never assume today or guess. Convert their reply (e.g. "25 December", "next Friday") to YYYY-MM-DD.

transfer_time.description: Transfer time (e.g. "14:30"). Ask the user naturally for their preferred time and convert to HH:MM. Defaults to now.
